name: South Australian law: the Acts in force, consolidated versions from the legislation website and the open data
label: South Australia
record_note: 581 South Australian Acts in force: 267 from their earliest RTF version on the South Australian Legislation website (1805 versions, data retrieved 2026-10-29), and 314 from the open data on data.sa.gov.au, from the version in force on 17 November 2017 (or the Act's first version since) through every fortnightly update package (1046 versions, sourced 2026-11-02); to 2026-10-03. The Acts from the open data were appended after the others: choose commits by their In-force trailer, per Act. Commits between versions are dated by the commencement in the legislative history; only version days are checked against official text. Older versions published only as PDF, versions before 17 November 2017 of the Acts from the open data, and ceased Acts are not included.

dates.time: 12:00 Adelaide (ACST, UTC+9:30; ACDT, UTC+10:30, in daylight saving time)

scope.when_absent: this corpus records no scope notes (no commit carries Applies:); the absence is not a statement that the change reaches every case

default_reach.rule: presumption against retrospective operation; repeal or amendment does not affect what was done or accrued before
default_reach.meaning: an Act is presumed not to operate retrospectively on substantive rights unless it says so; the repeal or amendment of an Act does not affect its previous operation or any right, liability or penalty acquired or incurred under it, unless the contrary intention appears
default_reach.authority: Acts Interpretation Act 1915 (SA) s 16 (effect of repeal or amendment); Maxwell v Murphy (1957) 96 CLR 261 (common-law presumption); not checked in this corpus

verification: Every version of every Act is checked against its official source on the Act's own commits (file by file, and letters and digits with a separate reader).
order: appended: an Act's commits are in date order, but Acts added later come after commits with later dates
